description*: Kill the Mad Angel after attacking her between each bounce of the blast attack during her enrage phase.
Kill the Mad Angel after getting 3 consecutive enhanced attacks by successfully praying against the smite attacks during her enrage phase.
tip: This achievement requires attacking between her smite triple attacks. Easiest with a 3-tick weapon, like the goblin paint cannon.

description*: Kill the Mad Angel after getting 6 consecutive enhanced attacks by dodging the sweep attack successfully during her enrage phase.
Kill the Mad Angel without taking any avoidable damage.
Kill the Mad Angel 5 times within 10 minutes of entering her arena.
Kill the Mad Angel 15 times without leaving her arena.
tip: Successfully performing the Mad Angel's mechanics for nearly all kills will be required for most players, to minimise damage taken. It is recommended to bring Saradomin brews to maximise available healing, and 8-12 super restores.

description*: Kill the Mad Angel without equipping any weapon.
tip: Thralls, off-hand equipment, and recoil effects are allowed to be used within the fight, and are recommended.
